stem.text: Two blocks, of mass $0.20\,\text{kg}$ and $0.50\,\text{kg}$, are connected by a light inextensible string that passes over a frictionless pulley.

stem.alt: Two blocks joined by a string over a pulley. One block rests on a rough horizontal surface; the other hangs vertically. Labels: rough horizontal surface, block mass 0.20 kg, pulley, block mass 0.50 kg.

stem.text: The blocks are initially held stationary. The block of mass $0.20\,\text{kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal surface.
The block of mass $0.50\,\text{kg}$ is suspended in air. Air resistance is negligible.
When the blocks are released, they have an acceleration of magnitude $2.0\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.
What is the magnitude of the frictional force between the block of mass $0.20\,\text{kg}$ and the rough surface?
